actions.name: Register on the ILookTV website using any of the following links:
Enter your username, email address, password, and password confirmation.
A verification code will then be sent to your email address. Enter the code to verify your email.
Next, log in to the website using the credentials you provided during registration.

name: Activating the trial period and/or purchasing a package

actions.name: After logging in, you'll see that one day of free viewing is available. You can proceed directly to the next step. However, once the free period expires, if you wish to continue watching, return to this step to top up your balance and purchase a package.

Once the trial period has expired, you will need to top up your account in your personal account area. To do this, go to "ACCOUNT" - "FINANCES" - "TOP UP". After adding funds, you need to activate a package. Go to the "PLAN" section and activate your chosen plan. We also recommend enabling automatic renewal.

name: Copying the playlist to your device's media player

actions.name: In your account area, open the "PLAYLIST" tab and go to "CHANNEL GROUPS". Select the playlist type: either "Standard" or "Thematic" (recommended), depending on which channel groups you need. You can also untick any channels you don't want to include.
Next, go to the "DOWNLOAD" section, select the playlist in m3u8 format, and save its URL. You can save the URL in a text file or simply take a screenshot.

NOTE: You can change the channel groups later without repeating the rest of the setup. Whenever you change the groups you want, simply open your player settings and look for the "Update playlist" or "Load playlist" option.
